title: oenothera mollissima var. longiflora
intro: Oenothera mollissima var. longiflora, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species within the Onagraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid that offers numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving heart health. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera mollissima var. longiflora include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating conditions such as eczema, arthritis, and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include GLA, as well as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic potential.
